question: Can frozen v20261010 CM membership, abundance structure and fixed-W activities be recovered within existing immune-related cohorts?
source_reason: Previously collected melanoma immunotherapy-related ecosystem, lung immune landscape, longitudinal lung T-cell subset, prostate immune/resistance-related human scope. No choice by current correlation or LR p-values.
scope: All source libraries in frozen1290, split by reviewed cancer/sample class/treatment phase. All9CM retained. No canonical/node renaming, new patient reassignment or new data download.
reference: Frozen172 W, original H, normalized frequency matrix, corrected120 CM edge records and exact node-major dictionary
core: Unique actual graph-member nodes per fixed CM, ordered by frozen W. Report top10 candidate nodes separately; do not mistake isolated top-weight nodes for graph members.

support.per_library_unambiguous_compartments: min(2,number of reference unambiguous compartments); T/NK and unspecified lymphoid do not create new distinct biological compartments
support.meaning: Operational diagnostic gates, not published CoVarNet validation thresholds or biological proof
support.sensitivity: Report all weight .4/.6/.8 by supported-library fractions .5/.8, not only a favourable threshold

sampling: GSE179994 is a published T-cell subset; non-T legacy labels are retained descriptively but excluded from whole-module capture/projection support. No whole-TME inference. Other sources preserve enrichment/material uncertainties.
projection: Keep original W scale and identities; fixed-W KL minimization, never learn W in target cohort. Primary uses frozen normalization with unobserved/inadequately captured majors masked and only varying rows; official-style cohort minmax as sensitivity. Report W rank/condition and no identifiable activity for rank<9/condition>1e8. H values alone are not module replication.
numerical_check: Independent scipy bounded objective minimization against multiplicative KL projection on up to3 fixed libraries per eligible cohort/normalization; save KKT and objective diagnostics. This is numerical checking, not independent biological validation.
coherence: Patient-block means when evidence reviewed, original sample fallback otherwise; complete measured-major blocks; exact frozen cross-major graph edges, endpoint count>=20 in>=50%blocks, >=10blocks and>=3 varying edges. Mean Spearman rho across all coverage-eligible edges, no positive-edge selection.
null: 1999 permutations of entire same-major rank vectors across blocks, keeping within-major covariance and closure; independent permutations across majors. Restrict to fixed source/cancer/material/treatment strata. Missing major is not biological0. 2000 block bootstrap with fixed edge set and>=1800estimable required for interval.
multiplicity: Diagnostic one-sided positive-coherence BH across all planned cohortx9CM tests; untestable internalp1, reportedp/qNA. Selected reference and sources were already seen; never call this independent validation.
independence: All four sources occur in frozen discovery1290. New GSE169246/GSE243013/etc currently lack accepted exact172 mapping; no guessed marker-name transport.
outputs: Public aggregate source/core/support/projection/coherence tables, input SHA manifest and heatmap. Private sample activities/fixtures stay in new server run directory.
